sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title, and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2019
ACT XIV OF 2019
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief
Minister
and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges)
Act, 1975 (Balochistan Act III of 1975)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
24th January, 2020]
No.
PAB / Legis: V (20) / 2019, dated 24.1.2020.---The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill No. 20 of 2019 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 21st November, 2019 and assented
to by the Governor Balochistan, on 23rd January, 2020 is hereby published as an
Act the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to amend the
Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (Balochistan Act III of 1975), in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title, and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill No. 20 of 2019 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 21st November, 2019 and assented

Act the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to amend the
Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (Balochistan Act III of 1975), in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of Section 7, Act III of 1975.---In
the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Balochistan Act III of 1975), section 7 shall be
numbered as subsection (1) of that section and after subsection (1) as so
numbered, the following new subsections (2), (3) and (4) shall be added,
namely: -
(2) The
Chief Minister may use an aircraft or helicopter of Government, at Government
expenses, for official use.
(3) The
Chief Minister may hire an aircraft or helicopter from open market or
requisition it from Pakistan Air Force or Federal Government for official use,
at the cost of the Government, in accordance with the rules made in this behalf
by the Pakistan Air Force or Federal Government, as the case may be.
(4) The
Chief Minister may allow Speaker, Deputy Speaker, a Minister, Opposition
Leader, or a public/civil servant for such official work to use an aircraft or
helicopter of Government for official use at Government expenses:
Provided
that the Chief Minister may also allow any person to use aircraft or helicopter
in emergency cases.
